notes: Both marginal literal glosses (sanctified, Galil) were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
hill country is headed on hill throughout, since country alone is any country (rule 31), with a supplied the on each construct (rule 29).
set apart keeps its particle with the verb and heads on set, since apart alone names nothing (rule 44's phrasal-particle clause).
Kiriath-arba is split because each morpheme has an English word of its own (rule 2); הִיא takes the identifying the same and the copula joins the predicate name (rules 18, 20).
